findings_qualitative.value: Most cores show blue profiles; cores 10, 11, 13 show red profiles; hub cores have higher infall rates

evidence.quote: the derived mass infall rates for the protostellar cores in hub-region is significantly higher in comparison to those located along the filaments.

claims.hypothesis: Filaments channel mass onto the central hub
claims.experiment: PV analysis of H13CO+ along filaments

evidence.quote: A mass inflow rate higher than $10^{3}$ M$_{\odot}$ Myr$^{-1}$ along the filaments

claims.experiment: H13CO+ and CCH profile classification and Hill5 fits
claims.finding: Collapse in most cores, expansion in a few

evidence.quote: the majority of the cores having the characteristic blue asymmetric line profiles

claims.experiment: M-R relation plus filament velocity profiles
claims.result: Massive-regime cores with red profiles lose gas to hub

evidence.quote: Our results are supporting a competitive accretion scenario of massive star formation

why_this_data.value: H13CO+ and CCH used since HCO+ is contaminated by outflows and CS has coarse resolution

evidence.quote: the HCO$^{+}$ line is significantly contaminated by outflow activities from the embedded protostars
